notes: Wix site (kinoamdach.at 301s to gogogo.at/kinoamdach); no ld+json/API, and the individual film titles/showtimes are not present in server HTML anywhere (filmprogramm/schedule/cinema/event sub-routes all serve the same client-routed shell with no embedded data, Wix Events app data is JS-fetched client-side only) — so like a months-long exhibition this emits ONE record for the whole season, parsed from the homepage banner ('01. JUNI – 12. SEPTEMBER 2026', season theme, price block, address). price_min is the reduced/Ermäßigung price (min of the two published prices).
